rule: WAITING is line-specific and never means mission IDLE or DONE. Blocked work registers its dependency and the mission continues with the highest-priority non-blocked item.

items.objective: Reconcile current feature-branch state with source-main mission evidence and current Git/PR/CI state.
items.problem: Current branch and source-main architecture remain distinct evidence layers.
items.authorized_action: Maintain explicit source-of-truth reconciliation and prevent unsupported promotion.
acceptance_criteria: No mission claimed operational solely from stale docs
items.validation_method: Git ref/commit inspection + registry validation + CI/PR inspection + persisted reconciliation

items.objective: Implement persistent append-only state-transition/event lineage with concurrency protection.
items.problem: Initial event primitives needed persistent and serialized writes.
items.authorized_action: Continue integrating event persistence into every lifecycle producer/consumer surface.

items.objective: Extend zero-context bootstrap from validation into complete state reconstruction/replay of registry, claims, handoffs and lifecycle history.
items.problem: Current bootstrap reconstructs and validates the persistent control-plane projection but does not yet replay every mutable registry transition from a canonical event stream.
items.authorized_action: Implement canonical replay for mission registry, work claims, handoffs, contributions, contradictions and lifecycle records; fail closed on divergence.

items.objective: Close the gap between repository-side authority contracts and actual platform/runtime enforcement.
items.problem: The repository can reject invalid requests, but GitHub/platform-level authority enforcement remains external/unverified.
items.authorized_action: Audit CODEOWNERS, branch protection, protected surfaces, authorization-loss paths and external root-of-trust; implement repository-side controls that can be closed without human credentials and persist external blockers.
items.validation_method: source/security audit + adversarial tests + GitHub evidence

items.objective: Demonstrate concurrent mission execution without lost state, duplicate claims or contradictory commits.
items.problem: Component-level concurrency is tested, but full cross-mission execution remains unverified.
items.authorized_action: Build deterministic multi-process fixtures for concurrent claims, event appends, CAS state updates and handoff integration.

items.objective: Execute all persisted control-plane adversarial scenarios and prevent NOT_EXECUTED from being promoted to PASS.
items.problem: The 20-scenario matrix now has executable tests for the previously incomplete registry, authorization-loss and repository-integrity cases, but current-head CI evidence must remain authoritative.
items.authorized_action: Observe current-head CI, reconcile matrix statuses and add tests for any remaining partial scenarios.

items.objective: Inspect existing warning, decision and action consumers before implementing response-coupling ledger functionality.
items.problem: Operational effectiveness requires linking warning, decision, response exposure and outcome ascertainment without duplicating existing contracts.
items.authorized_action: Source-inspect warning/decision/action consumers and existing persistence; produce response-coupling audit and only then implement justified ledger changes.
items.validation_method: source inspection + contract audit + adversarial tests + scientific consistency audit
